title: Great plan in Barcelona
text: Great plan in Barcelona! We enjoyed an incredible boat outing with friends, good music, spectacular views of the city, and a great atmosphere. A fun and different experience that we would repeat without hesitation. Highly recommended!
author: Enric2002

title: A must!!
text:
My partner and i went for a morning boat trip for his birthday present. Another couple were supposed to be there but unfortunately they couldn’t make it. And lucky us we had the boat just for us two. Days before the trip I’ve been in contact with them as the forecast has been changing they were very informative and considerate. And the captain was very nice and friendly. We defo had an amazing boat trip. Thank you very much 
100% recommended
author: Katherine Joyce V

title: Amazing boat trip
text: I went with my partner for his birthday surprise and there were supposed to be other people unlucky they couldn’t make but lucky us we had the boat just for us two. It was a nice sunny a wee bit chilly day trip. We had an amazing boat trip! The captain Cristian was  very nice and polite. We’ll definitely do it again just a different day of the year.
author: joizv2025

title: A luxury experience not only for tourists
text: I’m from Barcelona and it’s not the first time I’ve seen the city from the sea, but the afternoon we spent in the Skyfall was certainly the most pleasant, elegant and pleasant. The sun gently falling, the calm swing of the waves, the relaxed music in the background, a glass of wine and an aperitif on board the sailboat to say goodbye to the summer... All in a Mood careful to detail. A real luxury, not only for those who visit us, but also for those who are lucky enough to live here.
author: mariadevallibanas

title: Wonderful and beautiful
text:
We went as a group and the experience was wonderful, 100% recommended.
Beautiful also in part by Captain Christian which made everything very enjoyable, nice and pleasant paying the utmost attention to the Sailboat and us, special mention to his musical list of spotify!!!! ;)  
Laura

title: Formality, kindness, facilities, nice experience.
text: Excellent sailing with Cristian. The impeccable sailboat. Good deal, formality. At all times they responded to our requests. Nice experience.
author: 982rolandg

title: Wonderful sailing day with visit to vineyards and winery, exceptional!!
text: The boat far met our expectations very comfortable and well equipped, Cristian our captain/host was at all times attentive to our comfort and needs. We were on an Enterprise trip and had a great day, highly recommended to complement it with a visit to a winery
author: roland g

title: Exclusive Sailing Experience
text:
Christian was an amazing skipper and host. We only skirted the bay of Barcelona but that was due to the choppy waters, but felt comfortable safe and enjoyed the views and sunshine ☀️ 
Nice drinks on board… only 3 in total which made it feel very exclusive.
Fantastic experience - Thank you 🙏
